lines: ashes whisper in winds that dare not speak
their hollow truths, beneath skies veiled in grey
whispers of what was, and what might yet be
in deserts where shadows dance, under moons
that watch like sentinels of ancient time
the echoes of forgotten battles still ring
through silent nights, when stars alone shine
souls trapped between worlds, in silence they pray
for understanding, from their dark confines
to find a way, to break this endless cycle
of pain and suffering, forever entwined
beneath the moon's pale gaze, where shadows play
ancient bones whisper secrets in the night
desert winds howl through silent caverns deep
specters dance on whispers of forgotten dreams
eternal cycles spin in endless night
echoes fade, lost in silence's vast embrace
mourning lingers, a ghostly refrain
in darkness, only time holds truth's embrace
the desert waits, a timeless canvas
where stories are carved into stone and sand
whispers of the past, eternally entwined
in the heart of the night, beneath the cold stars' glance
